title: Zara bad ke dekho
body:
mohabbat ki waadi mein lut'ta lutata
masayeb ki dunya mein phirta phirata
nakahat se har gaam par dagmagata
sambhale huwe bediyan ladkhadata
mazaalim ke toofan se takra raha hai
zara bad ke dekho ye kaun aa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kis ke hai naizon pe sar aage aage
jo ab bhi hai seena sipar aage aage
sitaare hai peeche qamar aage aage
bahattar charagh humsafar aage aage
sawad e sar e shaam tharra raha hai
zara bad ke dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mukammal masayeb ke saanche mein dhal ke
hidayat ki raahon mein kaanton pe chal ke
faqat ye nahi ke kiya sabr balke
zara sabr ki hadh se baahar nikal ke
imamat ki taaqat ko dikhla raha hai
zara bad ke dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
sataate hai behad ye paon ke chaale
aur in mein wo kaante ke jaise ho bhaale
magar kya kare kaise unko nikaale
ye kaante nikaale ke langar sambhale
taras bhi to koi nahi khaa raha hai
zara bad ke dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
araq rezma tha shikan dar shikan hai
labon ki khamoshi sukhan dar sukhan hai
kalayi to dekho rasan dar rasan hai
magar phir bhi ye gul chaman dar chaman hai
jo aaj apni khushboo ko phaila raha hai
zara bad ke dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ummat ke haathon sataya gaya hai
ye qaidi nahi hai banaya gaya hai
ye baaghi nahi hai bataya gaya hai
isay suye darbar laaya gaya hai
ye haq hai ke baatil se takra raha hai
zara bad ke dekho...
author: Hasan Imdad
